protocol_revision_reason: ARA replication exposed a missing minimum-duration eligibility rule before scoring

held_out_selection.fieldsite_rule: Exclude BEJ, WEL, and ARA; then choose the lexicographically first remaining fieldsite with at least four B/D-paired participants whose four lowest paired IDs do not appear in retained evidence. ACO and HAD through MBE are excluded by prior exact-ID evidence; MEN is first eligible.
held_out_selection.sequential_rule: Fetch both B and D for candidates in numeric order. Keep a participant only if both decoded WAV durations are at least 2.10 seconds. Stop immediately after four eligible participants. Do not replace or skip for any acoustic or predictive property.
held_out_selection.minimum_duration_derivation: 50 ms non-overlapping frames require at least 42 frames: 40 calibration frames, one current frame, and one following prediction target

frozen_learner.model: four-by-four smoothed local transition counts trained only on Beijing

failure_policy: Retain any eligibility or scoring failure. Do not change fieldsite, candidate order, duration rule, selected participants, training clips, event thresholds, baselines, or acceptance thresholds after fetching begins.
claim_boundary: A pass would independently replicate the Beijing-trained unlabeled event-dynamics advantage in MEN after a purely duration-based eligibility screen. It would not establish semantic prediction, IDS/ADS recognition, universality, live operation, or dropout robustness.
